references.text: Kinneret (Sea of Kinneret) is mentioned as a geographical boundary marker, the same sea that is called the Sea of Kinneret here
The Arabah valley and the area south of the Sea of Kinneret are described as part of Israel's territory
The king of Dor in Naphtoth-Dor is mentioned as one of the kings who were defeated, the same area referred to here
Dor and its villages are mentioned as part of Manasseh's inheritance, the same coastal region referenced
Dor and its surrounding villages are mentioned in connection with the continued settlement of the Canaanites
Naphtoth-Dor is mentioned as one of Solomon's administrative districts, the same area referred to in Joshua
The lowland (Shephelah) and the coast are mentioned as areas where the kings gathered against Israel
The mountains, the Negev, the lowland, and the foothills are mentioned as areas that Joshua conquered, the same geographical regions
